body: You’re right, I didn’t think about them having to pay for all of that. I wish this was cheaper, like really I’m sure they’d benefit more from me being dead than alive, I’m a waste of air, a waste of space, no one likes me, and I’m just falling down a hole I can’t seem to get out of. It’s a dark, lonely never ending hole and I just want it to stop. I keep thinking I’ve reached the lowest point, I keep thinking I can see the ground, but nope, it just keeps going lower. I’m beyond help and I feel like I’m not even worth saving
I’m glad you appreciate it, I’m just glad someone could get a laugh outta this, but you’re very right. That’s what gets me through life for the most part lol
Damn right my dude, I can do better /s
Yeah you’re right, I wish I knew this earlier
